subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Team Building Retreat
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce our Annual Team Building Retreat scheduled for next month. This year's event will be held at a beautiful resort in the countryside, offering a mix of team-building activities, workshops, and networking opportunities. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details on the agenda and registration process. We look forward to a fun and productive retreat with all of you! Best regards, The Organizing Committee
